name: D2-v2: relevance-gated NLI grounding, fixed on Set A+B (exploratory; Set B informed the design)

gate.rule: eligible candidates: r(c) >= r(released choice) - delta; released choice always eligible

formula: among eligible candidates, max of released + alpha * (g_mean - ISSUP)

commands.set_C: python grounding/rerank_ground.py --f results/runs/asqa_cands_C.json --ground results/runs/cand_ground_C.jsonl --split critique/splits/asqa_C.json --mode mix --agg mean --param 0.75 --rel results/runs/cand_qarel_C.jsonl --delta 1 --out out/rr_ground_v2_C.json
